proposal.summary: Reporter observed the desktop client making requests to an unfamiliar address at startup and could not determine whether personal data was included; they reported it for security review.

AV.quote: your desktop client sometimes sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up

C.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the client startup network activity: capture and analyze outbound requests (endpoints, headers, payloads) and determine whether sensitive data is transmitted; if confirmed, identify cause and remediate or disclose.
